system.notes:
Spectral carriage pulled by skeletal horses and emitting purple flames. Carries misfortunate souls to Hell.

AC 14, HP 40, ATK collect soul, MV near (fly), S -4, D +4, C +4, I +2, W +3, Ch +5, AL C, LV 8

Aura of Doom. All mortals within near, CHA 15+ or terrified for 1d4 rounds.

Collect Soul. One target within close of coach, WIS 15+ or become incorporeal and trapped inside carriage, 1d6 CON damage per round. DISADV on WIS check if terrified. Die at 0 CON, soul trapped in coach forever.

Greater Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Incorporeal. In place of attacks, become corporeal or incorporeal.
